subject: design-technology

moments.title: Macintosh launched
moments.body: The Mac brings a graphical interface and mouse to a mass-market computer.
moments.takeaway: Personal computing became designable, not just programmable.

moments.title: iPod
moments.body: The iPod combines a hard drive, a scroll wheel and iTunes integration. '1,000 songs in your pocket' becomes the slogan.
moments.takeaway: Successful products integrate hardware, software and service.

moments.title: iPhone
moments.body: The iPhone collapses iPod, phone and internet device into one multi-touch screen.
moments.takeaway: A single product can restructure entire industries.

now.title: Smartphone era
now.body: Most adults now carry a smartphone. Repairability, screen time and data ownership are growing concerns.
now.open_questions: What follows the rectangle in our pocket?

reflection: Industrial design's most visible 21st-century products are mostly made of glass and rare-earth metals.
